summary: Tested the redesigned Anunțuri feature end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_announcements.py (13 tests) covering GET /api/notifications (auth + exactly 3 seeded broadcasts, categories, ordering, no _id leak), GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/announcements, 403 for non-admins, validation and error cases — all 13 pass after one fix. Found and fixed a CRITICAL 500 on POST /api/admin/announcements (ObjectId leak). Frontend: verified list page (3 cards, badges, dates, NOU, sidebar 'Anunțuri de top' + 'Sfatul zilei'), detail page for the autumn update (hero, Update badge, date/time, Echipa Cartoonix + verified badge, full body sections, no PLUS benefits grid), 'Sistem' badge on security announcement, share buttons, 'Alte anunțuri' navigation, detail-back/ann-back, invalid-id fallback, and Admin → Anunțuri publish/delete round-trip (item appeared on public list, then deleted). DB left with exactly the original 3 announcements.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: returned 500 (ValueError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable) on every call because motor's insert_one mutates `doc` adding `_id` (ObjectId) which was then spread into the JSON response. The announcement WAS still inserted, so each failed admin publish silently created a record while showing an error toast. Fixed by excluding `_id` from the response dict (server.py:2076). Admin publish now works in UI + API.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and test_cinema.py are stale (register is now /auth/register/start + /verify, and it hardcodes the old admin password 'Cartoonix2026!'). 10 failed / 7 errors there are unrelated to announcements.

Pre-existing architecture notes from playbook checklist: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True (browsers reject credentialed wildcard); auth uses JWT bearer token in JSON (no httpOnly cookie); no brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (failed attempts are not counted). bcrypt hashes verified correct ($2b$12$).

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 390px: each announcement card is 413px wide inside a 390px viewport (document.scrollWidth=429), so the right part of the card (chevron area) is clipped/scrolls off-screen. Needs min-w-0 / w-full fix on the card's inner flex row.
Date/time and the 'NOU' badge are hidden below the sm breakpoint (`hidden sm:flex`), so mobile users see no publish date although the mockup shows it.

Category badge in 'Anunțuri publicate' is always purple and shows the raw lowercase key ('update', 'sistem') instead of the category label/color used on the public pages. Also delete acts immediately with no confirmation dialog.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking share-copy produced no 'Link copiat!' toast in the automated browser (navigator.clipboard blocked without permission in headless). Likely environment-only; consider a document.execCommand fallback so the copy works in restricted contexts.

rca_of_the_issue: POST /api/admin/announcements built `doc`, called `await db.notifications.insert_one(doc)` and returned `{**doc}` filtering only 'user_id'. Motor/PyMongo injects the generated `_id` (bson ObjectId) into `doc` in place, so the response contained a non-JSON-serialisable ObjectId → FastAPI serialisation ValueError → HTTP 500 while the document was already persisted. Reproduction: admin POST any announcement → 500 but item appears in GET /api/admin/announcements. Mitigation applied: exclude both 'user_id' and '_id' from the response payload; verified via test_create_appears_in_list_and_notifications_then_delete and the Admin UI publish/delete round-trip.
